_comment: UK direct debit failure rate — share of direct debits returned unpaid due to insufficient funds. Sourced from ONS 'Monthly Direct Debit failure rate and average transaction amount' dataset (Pay.UK / Vocalink data, ONS calculations). Series used: Table 1, 'DD Failure Rates Total NSA' (all categories, non-seasonally adjusted, total).

methodology.indicator: BACS-administered direct debit failure rate, monthly, % of total direct debit transactions, total all categories, non-seasonally adjusted (NSA)
methodology.release_cadence: monthly dataset release accompanying the ONS 'Economic activity and social change in the UK, real-time indicators' bulletin (typically published mid-month, reporting data through ~6 weeks earlier)
methodology.extraction_notes: The curated series stores one decimal place, matching its historical convention; the live fixture keeps the ONS chart CSV's two-decimal figure. The 'published' field records when each reference month first appeared, and the adapter persists it as released_at to avoid historical lookahead. The ONS 17 September 2026 bulletin Figure 4 CSV reports Total NSA August = 2.41% (rounded here to 2.4); the accompanying 2026 dataset workbook sheet '2.DD Failure Rates Total NSA' gives 2.40%, a 0.01 percentage-point disagreement between official artefacts. July similarly differs (chart 2.44%, workbook 2.43%). This series follows the chart CSV for the latest live value. The workbook is available at https://www.ons.gov.uk/file?uri=%2Feconomy%2Feconomicoutputandproductivity%2Foutput%2Fdatasets%2Fmonthlydirectdebitfailurerateandaveragetransactionamount%2F2026%2Fdirectdebittransactionsandfailuresdataset170926.xlsx . Earlier curated points cite the dataset landing page; the August point cites the bulletin chart CSV.
